headline: The Fed Held.
Two Officials
Wanted

slides.subtitle: Oct. 28 decision: rates stay at 3.75% to 4.00%.

slides.title: What Happened?
slides.big: The Fed held rates at 3.75% to 4.00%.
slides.body: The vote was 10-2. Governors Lisa Cook and Beth Hammack dissented, preferring a quarter-point hike.
